events.event: Señor de los Milagros Procession (Mes Morado)
events.eventDates: Oct 1 - Oct 31 (main processions mid and late Oct)
events.hook: A purple-robed sea of devotees carries a colonial image through Lima's streets.
events.overview: Lima's Mes Morado is one of the world's largest Catholic processions, with hundreds of thousands in purple walking behind an image of Christ painted by an Angolan slave. Turrón de Doña Pepa nougat sweets and street food stalls line the route. It is combined easily with Lima's top-ranked restaurants.
events.costNotes: Peru is inexpensive, with Lima's fine dining the main splurge.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cusco, Peru","event":"Pre-rainy-season Andean trekking and Inca sites","note":"Same flight corridor with shoulder-season crowds."},{"destination":"Guanajuato, Mexico","event":"Festival Internacional Cervantino","note":"Mexico's biggest arts festival runs through the autumn."}]

events.eventDates: Late Jul - Oct (herds begin leaving in late Oct)
events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest plunge across the Mara River past waiting crocodiles.
events.overview: The herds follow the rains between Tanzania's Serengeti and Kenya's Mara, and dramatic crossings of the Mara River happen through October. Late in the month the herds begin drifting back south, and the crowds thin out. Expect predators, big skies and unmatched wildlife drama.
events.costNotes: Park fees, game drives and a Nairobi-Mara flight dominate the experience budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti, Tanzania","event":"Herds heading south toward the Serengeti plains","note":"The northern Serengeti is quieter than the Mara and still has crossings."},{"destination":"Etosha, Namibia","event":"Dry season waterhole game viewing","note":"Elephants and rhinos gather at floodlit waterholes in October."}]

events.hook: America's witchiest town goes full Halloween for an entire month.
events.overview: Salem runs a month-long Halloween celebration with parades, costumed street life, ghost tours, psychic fairs and a Grand Parade. Historic Witch Trials sites and a moody New England harbor make it the ultimate Halloween-week trip. The final weekend is the biggest.
events.costNotes: Salem lodging is at a yearly peak in October, so staying in nearby Boston or Beverly can cut costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sleepy Hollow, United States","event":"The Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze","note":"Thousands of hand-carved pumpkins along the Hudson River."},{"destination":"New Orleans, United States","event":"Halloween season and Oak Street Po-Boy-style ghost tours","note":"Gothic cemeteries and costume parties through Halloween weekend."}]

events.event: International White Truffle Fair of Alba
events.hook: Hunt, sniff and eat the world's most coveted truffle in the Piedmont vineyards.
events.overview: Alba's truffle fair fills the old town with the white truffle market, tasting events, cooking shows and the Palio degli Asini donkey race. Truffle hunts in the Langhe hills and Barolo and Barbaresco cellars add to the autumn harvest. Late October is peak season, with fog, vines turning gold and truffles shaved onto everything.
events.costNotes: Truffle dishes and wine push the food budget above the usual Italian level.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Istria, Croatia","event":"Truffle season in Motovun","note":"Cheaper white truffle hunting with Adriatic scenery."},{"destination":"San Miniato, Italy","event":"White Truffle Fair (Nov start)","note":"Tuscan alternative that opens in November, so earlier visits only catch the build-up."}]

events.hook: Over 100 giant sculptures line the Bondi to Tamarama clifftop coast walk.
events.overview: The world's largest free outdoor sculpture exhibition winds along Sydney's cliffs, with the Pacific crashing below. Pair it with spring beach weather, swimming in ocean pools and Sydney's food scene. Evening events and sunrise visits are the best ways to see it.
events.costNotes: Sydney lodging and food are pricey, but the exhibition itself is free.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hervey Bay, Australia","event":"Humpback whale season","note":"Whale watching through October and early November."},{"destination":"Margaret River, Australia","event":"Spring wildflowers and wine","note":"Western Australia's coast in spring bloom."}]

events.event: Derry Halloween (Banks of the Foyle Carnival)
events.hook: Europe's biggest Halloween party, in a walled city that claims to be its birthplace.
events.overview: Derry's Halloween festival draws tens of thousands to the 17th-century walled city for a carnival parade, fireworks over the River Foyle, and a spooky street festival with costumes. It plays on the Celtic roots of Samhain. It is more local and less commercial than American Halloween trips, and Giant's Causeway is a day away.
events.costNotes: Lodging is limited and book out, so plan ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Dublin, Ireland","event":"Bram Stoker Festival","note":"Gothic literary festival around Halloween weekend."},{"destination":"Edinburgh, United Kingdom","event":"Samhain Fire Festival and ghost tours","note":"Fire-lit Samhain celebrations on Calton Hill."}]

events.event: Lai Rua Fai Illuminated Boat Festival and Naga Fireballs (Ok Phansa)
events.hook: Glowing fire boats drift down the Mekong while mysterious fireballs rise from the river.
events.overview: At the end of Buddhist Lent, Isaan towns along the Mekong float illuminated boats and launch lanterns. Nakhon Phanom's boat parade is the most spectacular, and Nong Khai is famed for the Naga fireballs said to rise from the river on Ok Phansa night. It is far from the tourist crowds, with beautiful Lao views across the river.
events.costNotes: Fly to Bangkok then a domestic flight to Nakhon Phanom or Udon Thani; lodging is cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Boat Racing Festival (Lai Heua Fai)","note":"Lao Ok Phansa celebrations with fire boats on the Mekong."},{"destination":"Chiang Mai, Thailand","event":"Pre-Yi Peng lantern season","note":"Quieter lantern atmosphere before the November festivals."}]

events.hook: Japan's biggest film festival lands in Tokyo as the autumn season arrives.
events.overview: The festival screens international premieres, Japanese cinema and anime, with talks and red carpet events across Ginza, Marunouchi and Hibiya. Cool autumn weather suits wandering Tokyo's neighborhoods, izakayas and early-autumn gardens. The trip combines well with a few days in Kyoto.
events.costNotes: Tokyo is moderately priced for a world city, with the weak yen helping.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Early autumn foliage and temple illuminations","note":"Foliage starts to turn in the northern hills in late October."},{"destination":"Busan, South Korea","event":"Autumn food and harbor culture","note":"Film-city vibe after BIFF with smaller crowds."}]

events.hook: Marigold altars, cemetery vigils and candlelit comparsas turn Oaxaca into the Day of the Dead capital.
events.overview: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead brings candlelit panteón vigils, sand tapestries, parades with costumes and face paint, and markets overflowing with pan de muerto and mezcal. Nearby villages like Xoxocotlán hold their own all-night rituals. Mexico's most moving festival is also delicious.
events.costNotes: Lodging rates jump sharply around Oct 31-Nov 2, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pátzcuaro, Mexico","event":"Janitzio Island Night of the Dead vigil","note":"Candlelit lake vigil with a more intimate crowd."},{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Day of the Dead parade and altars","note":"Easier to reach, with huge public altars."}]

events.hook: The race that stops a nation, with hats, champagne and Flemington glamour.
events.overview: The Cup Carnival at Flemington opens with Derby Day on Oct 31 and peaks with the Melbourne Cup on Nov 3, when Australia literally pauses at 3pm. Fashion, spring racing and Melbourne's laneway restaurants make for a lively city trip. Dress codes and tickets sell out quickly.
events.costNotes: Racing tickets and fashion add to the experiential cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Barossa Valley spring wine season","note":"Cellar-door tastings in spring weather."},{"destination":"Hobart, Tasmania","event":"Spring food and wine trails","note":"Smaller, quieter alternative with great produce."}]

events.hook: Over two million spectators cheer 50,000 runners through all five boroughs.
events.overview: The world's biggest marathon crosses five bridges and ends in Central Park. Spectating is a spectacle in itself, from the roar on First Avenue to the cowbells in Brooklyn. Fall in New York also means foliage, theater and food on the days around the race.
events.costNotes: Race-weekend hotel and Airbnb prices are the main cost driver.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Boston, USA","event":"Peak late-autumn foliage and fall culture","note":"Cheaper, walkable, and good for a quieter East Coast trip."},{"destination":"Philadelphia, USA","event":"Philadelphia Marathon weekend (late Nov)","note":"A smaller, friendlier marathon later in the month."}]

events.hook: Torch-bearing bonfire societies, flaming tar barrels and fireworks in an English town that takes Guy Fawkes Night to the extreme.
events.overview: Lewes holds Britain's most spectacular Bonfire Night, with thousands of costumed marchers carrying flaming torches through narrow streets. Societies stage processions and burn effigies, and the night ends in huge fireworks displays. It is loud, smoky and unlike anything else in England.
events.costNotes: Stay in nearby Brighton as Lewes rooms sell out; trains stop early on the night.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ottery St Mary, United Kingdom","event":"Tar Barrels night (Nov 5)","note":"Locals run burning barrels through the streets, a rawer tradition."},{"destination":"Edinburgh, Scotland","event":"Bonfire Night fireworks and early winter culture","note":"Less intense, with an atmospheric old town."}]

events.hook: The Pink City glows with millions of lamps, lit bazaars and fireworks on India's biggest night.
events.overview: Jaipur's markets, such as Johari and Bapu Bazaar, are strung with lights for Diwali. Families light diyas, share sweets and set off fireworks, and the palaces and forts shine against the dusk. It is a vivid way to see the biggest festival in Hindu India.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fares are steep, but on-the-ground costs are low.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali (Nov 24)","note":"Millions of lamps line the Ganges ghats two weeks after Diwali."},{"destination":"Kathmandu, Nepal","event":"Tihar festival of lights","note":"Five days of lamps, flowers and dogs and crows being honored, over the same dates."}]

events.hook: Thousands of camels, desert horsemen and pilgrims bathing in the sacred lake in Rajasthan.
events.overview: Pushkar's fair is a livestock market, a pilgrimage and a carnival in one. Camels are traded, decorated and raced, while pilgrims bathe in the lake on the full moon of Kartik Purnima. Expect turban-tying contests, folk music and sunsets over the dunes.
events.costNotes: Tent camps and guesthouses fill up in the final days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Varanasi, India","event":"Dev Deepawali (Nov 24)","note":"The same full moon, celebrated with lamps along the Ganges."},{"destination":"Jaisalmer, India","event":"Desert dunes and fort stays","note":"Quieter Thar desert alternative in cooler season."}]

events.hook: Swahili dhow races, donkey races and henna in a car-free UNESCO island town.
events.overview: Lamu's festival celebrates Swahili heritage with dhow sailing races, donkey races, poetry, craft displays and traditional dance. The old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site with no cars, so everything happens on foot or by boat. It is a lesser-known gem on the Kenyan coast.
events.costNotes: Flights via Nairobi are the main cost, and dates should be confirmed with the organizers.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Stone Town cultural scene and spice tours","note":"A similar Swahili-coast culture, with beaches nearby."},{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Marrakech International Film Festival (late Nov/early Dec)","note":"A big cultural event in a different part of Africa."}]

events.hook: Venetians walk across a floating pontoon bridge over the Grand Canal to thank the Madonna.
events.overview: This Venetian festival dates to 1630, when the city built the Salute basilica after a plague. A temporary pontoon bridge spans the Grand Canal, and locals cross to light candles and eat castradina, a mutton stew. It is a rare local holiday in a city that is otherwise quiet in late November.
events.costNotes: Low-season Venice lodging is cheaper than summer.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmärik Christmas market (opens late Nov)","note":"Europe's oldest Christmas market, opening around Nov 27."},{"destination":"Trieste, Italy","event":"Autumn city festivals","note":"A quiet Adriatic alternative near Venice."}]

events.hook: Thousands of paper lanterns float into the night sky while krathong floats drift down the river.
events.overview: On the full moon of the twelfth lunar month, Chiang Mai combines Yi Peng's lanterns with Loy Krathong's candlelit floats. Temples, the Ping River and the old city fill with light, parades and music. Public gatherings are the best way to see it, and the mass lantern releases are usually ticketed events.
events.costNotes: Mass lantern-release tickets are extra, and hotels cost more for those nights.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sukhothai, Thailand","event":"Loy Krathong at the historic park","note":"Where the tradition is said to have begun, with a light show among ruins."},{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Boun Lai Heua Fai","note":"Boat-light festival on the Mekong, with the same moon."}]

events.hook: Africa's biggest street party, with feathers, drums and a month of Cross River celebration.
events.overview: Calabar Carnival is a month-long festival with a grand parade of costumed bands, concerts, a car-free street party and a Christmas village. It draws crowds from across West Africa and the diaspora. The main parade and finale are in the last week of December, so check the schedule and current travel advice.
events.costNotes: Flights are via Lagos or Abuja, and a Nigeria visa is required.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Accra, Ghana","event":"Detty December concerts and beach parties","note":"Afrobeats shows, beach parties and a big diaspora crowd."},{"destination":"Douz, Tunisia","event":"International Festival of the Sahara (typically late Dec)","note":"Camel races and desert culture, with dates to be confirmed."}]

events.hook: Naga tribes gather in warrior dress for India's most vivid cultural showcase.
events.overview: Held at Kisama Heritage Village near Kohima, the Hornbill Festival brings together Nagaland's 16 tribes for war dances, folk songs, crafts, indigenous games and food stalls. It also hosts the Hornbill Rock Contest and a night market. It is far from the usual circuit and rewards the effort.
events.costNotes: Flights via Delhi or Kolkata to Dimapur are the main cost, while homestays are cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Chichibu, Japan","event":"Chichibu Night Festival (Dec 2-3)","note":"Floats and fireworks on winter nights in the mountains near Tokyo."},{"destination":"Kolkata, India","event":"Park Street Christmas celebrations","note":"Lights and old-city atmosphere, a good pairing with Northeast India."}]

events.hook: The Americas' biggest art fair, with a week of parties around it.
events.overview: Art Basel brings top galleries and collectors to the Miami Beach Convention Center, with satellite fairs, installations and pop-ups across Wynwood and the Design District. It is a high-energy mix of art, fashion, music and nightlife in warm December weather. Book early because the dates are the most expensive of the year.
events.costNotes: Flights are cheap from LAX, but lodging around the fair is at peak rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Mexico City, Mexico","event":"Feast of the Virgin of Guadalupe (Dec 12)","note":"Millions of pilgrims arrive at the Basilica, in a city with a strong art scene."},{"destination":"Medellín, Colombia","event":"Alumbrados Navideños","note":"Rivers and parks decorated with millions of lights from early December."}]

events.hook: Candlelit Lucia processions and Nobel pageantry turn Stockholm into a Scandinavian Christmas fairy tale.
events.overview: Nobel Week brings laureate lectures, exhibitions and the Dec 10 ceremony and banquet to the city. It ends with Lucia on Dec 13, when choirs in white robes and candle crowns sing in churches and museums. Add Gamla Stan's Christmas market and you have a very atmospheric week.
events.costNotes: Winter flights to Stockholm are moderate, and the Nobel and Lucia weeks lift lodging prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Rovaniemi, Finland","event":"Santa Claus Village and Lapland aurora season","note":"Same Nordic winter-lights mood, with reindeer and northern lights added."},{"destination":"Prague, Czechia","event":"Old Town Square Christmas Market","note":"Cheaper than Stockholm, with a storybook Christmas market."}]

events.hook: Four nights when an entire city becomes a light-art canvas.
events.overview: Lyon's festival began with candles in windows on Dec 8 and now fills streets, bridges and façades with projection mapping and installations. Over a million visitors wander between displays, and the food scene (bouchons, praline brioche) is a draw of its own. The exact 2026 window should be confirmed with the city.
events.costNotes: Lyon is easy to reach via Paris or Geneva, and festival-night lodging books early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Strasbourg, France","event":"Christkindelsmärik Christmas Market","note":"One of Europe's oldest Christmas markets, with Alsatian food and wine."},{"destination":"Basel, Switzerland","event":"Basler Weihnachtsmarkt","note":"Compact, elegant market on the Rhine, close to France and Germany."}]

events.hook: Giant kaleidoscopic lanterns with thousands of bulbs dance in time to music.
events.overview: San Fernando, the Christmas Capital of the Philippines, hosts barangays competing with huge star lanterns that pulse and spin in choreographed light shows. The festival is usually held on the Saturday before Christmas, and the whole Pampanga region is in holiday mode with Kapampangan food. The exact date should be confirmed locally.
events.costNotes: San Fernando is about two hours from Manila, so base there for a cheap trip.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full Moon Lantern Night (Dec 24)","note":"The old town turns off electric lights and floats lanterns on the river."},{"destination":"Hong Kong","event":"Winterfest and harbour light shows","note":"Big-city lights, markets and food."}]

events.event: Noche de Rábanos (Night of the Radishes)
events.hook: Elaborate scenes carved from giant radishes fill the zócalo for one night only.
events.overview: Since 1897, Oaxaca's growers and artists have carved oversized radishes into nativity scenes, mythical figures and local history for one evening. Crowds queue for hours to see them, and the city around is full of calendas, posadas and mezcal. Book lodging early because it is Oaxaca's busiest week.
events.costNotes: Flights are mid-priced, and the week before Christmas is high season for lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miguel de Allende, Mexico","event":"Las Posadas processions (Dec 16-24)","note":"Candlelit street processions and piñatas in a colonial town."},{"destination":"Puebla, Mexico","event":"Christmas season and Talavera markets","note":"Crafts, cuisine and a lively holiday plaza."}]

events.hook: Over a hundred yachts race out of Sydney Harbour on Boxing Day.
events.overview: The 628-nautical-mile race starts at Sydney Harbour on Boxing Day, when thousands watch from the shore and the water. A few days later the fleet arrives in Hobart, and the waterfront turns into a summer party. Combine it with Hobart's Taste of Tasmania food festival, which begins around Dec 28.
events.costNotes: Peak Australian summer holiday pricing applies to flights and lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Boxing Day Test at the MCG","note":"The traditional cricket event, with huge crowds."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"New Year's Eve at the Sky Tower","note":"Summer fireworks and easy access to beaches and islands."}]

events.hook: Dawn parade of cowbells, goatskin drums and enormous crepe-paper costumes.
events.overview: Junkanoo is the Bahamas' great street parade, held from about 2 a.m. on Boxing Day and again on New Year's Day. Rival groups compete with hand-built costumes, brass and cowbell rushes along Bay Street. Pair it with beach time and conch fritters.
events.costNotes: Holiday flights via Miami or Fort Lauderdale are pricey, and Christmas lodging is at a peak.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Juan, Puerto Rico","event":"Parrandas navideñas and Christmas season","note":"Long Puerto Rican Christmas with music, food and Old San Juan lights."},{"destination":"Key West, USA","event":"New Year's Eve celebrations","note":"Offbeat NYE drops and street parties without a passport."}]

events.hook: Torchlight procession, street party and fireworks under a castle.
events.overview: Hogmanay is Scotland's New Year, and Edinburgh's multi-day version has a torchlit procession, concerts, ceilidhs and the big Princes Street party with fireworks over the castle. It is one of the world's great New Year celebrations. Tickets for the main street party sell out.
events.costNotes: Holiday flights and New Year lodging are the biggest costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Reykjavik, Iceland","event":"New Year's Eve bonfires and fireworks","note":"Locals set off fireworks over the whole city, and aurora are possible."},{"destination":"Berlin, Germany","event":"Silvester at the Brandenburg Gate","note":"Huge open-air party with big-name acts and a midnight fireworks display."}]

events.hook: Brass bands, banjos and sequined minstrels dance through the Cape Town streets on the 'Second New Year'.
events.overview: Tweede Nuwe Jaar is a Cape Malay and Cape Coloured tradition dating back to the era of emancipation. Troupes in bright satin suits and painted faces march and sing through the city center and Bo-Kaap. It lands in peak Cape summer, so you can pair it with beaches, wine country and Table Mountain.
events.costNotes: Peak-summer flights and housing; Cape Town food stays cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Zanzibar, Tanzania","event":"Post-New Year beach and Swahili culture","note":"Similar warm-season holiday energy with Stone Town culture and spice markets."},{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Lavagem do Bonfim (mid-January)","note":"Another street celebration of Afro-descended heritage, with music and procession."}]

events.event: Harbin International Ice and Snow Festival
events.hook: A glowing city of full-size ice palaces at -20°C.
events.overview: Harbin carves enormous ice buildings from Songhua River ice, lights them in neon, and fills the Sun Island snow sculpture park with giant works. January is the coldest and most reliable month for the ice. Add ice swimming, the Siberian Tiger Park and Russian-influenced food.
events.costNotes: Winter gear is extra; entry to Ice and Snow World is the main activity expense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sapporo, Japan","event":"Preparations for Sapporo Snow Festival (early Feb)","note":"Cold-weather snow and ice art, with easier logistics but a slightly later event."},{"destination":"Quebec City, Canada","event":"Quebec Winter Carnival and Ice Hotel","note":"Ice sculptures and a snowy old town closer to LAX."}]

events.hook: Gujarat's skies fill with a million kites for Makar Sankranti.
events.overview: Gujarat's Uttarayan turns rooftops into battlegrounds as families fly razor-string kites and cheer 'Kai Po Che!'. The international festival adds kite makers from dozens of countries and giant sculptural kites. Try undhiyu and chikki, and visit Ahmedabad's UNESCO-listed old city.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fares via Gulf or Europe; very low on-the-ground costs.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jaipur, India","event":"Jaipur Literature Festival (late Jan)","note":"Pair Rajasthan's culture with a world-class book festival; dates shift yearly."},{"destination":"Bhuj, India","event":"Rann Utsav, Kutch","note":"Cultural festival on the white salt desert, a few hours from Ahmedabad."}]

events.hook: White-robed pilgrims escort the Ark replicas to Fasilides' Bath in a sea of color.
events.overview: Timkat commemorates the baptism of Christ with all-night vigils, processions and a mass blessing at Gondar's Fasilides Bath. Priests in embroidered robes carry the tabots under ceremonial umbrellas to the sound of sistrums and drums. Combine with the Simien Mountains and Lalibela for a full northern Ethiopia loop.
events.costNotes: Includes domestic flights and guides; hotels in Gondar sell out for Timkat.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Genna (Ethiopian Christmas, Jan 7)","note":"Pilgrims fill the rock-hewn churches; falls early in the month."},{"destination":"Jerusalem, Israel","event":"Armenian and Orthodox Christmas observances","note":"Another ancient Christian tradition in a deeply historic setting."}]

events.hook: The Grand Slam of Asia-Pacific, played in the Melbourne summer heat.
events.overview: Melbourne Park hosts two weeks of tennis, with outer-court matches, night sessions on Rod Laver Arena and a festival atmosphere in the courtyard. The city around it has great coffee, laneway bars and street art. Use the rest of the trip for the Great Ocean Road or Phillip Island.
events.costNotes: Ground passes are cheaper than reserved seats in Rod Laver Arena; accommodation spikes in the second week.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Sydney Festival","note":"Large arts festival across the city through January."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"ASB Classic tennis and summer festivals","note":"A warm-up tennis event with a smaller scale and a more relaxed pace."}]

events.hook: Twenty-four hours of drumming by thousands of people dressed as cooks and soldiers.
events.overview: At midnight on January 19 the flag is raised in Plaza de la Constitución and the whole city begins to drum. Costumed groups parade until midnight on the 20th, with pintxo bars full the whole time. It is a rare winter chance to see Basque culture and the best food town in Spain without the summer crowds.
events.costNotes: Fly into Bilbao or Biarritz; the food budget is high because pintxo hopping is the point.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bilbao, Spain","event":"Basque winter pintxo and Guggenheim scene","note":"Cheaper, easy to combine with San Sebastián by bus."},{"destination":"Lyon, France","event":"Winter gastronomy and Sirha food fair (Jan)","note":"The French food capital in January, with a major trade fair."}]

events.event: Fiestas de la Calle San Sebastián
events.hook: Old San Juan turns into a four-day street party with bomba, salsa and giant 'cabezudo' heads.
events.overview: This closing party of Puerto Rico's long Christmas season fills the blue cobblestone streets with artisans, food stalls and live music. Crowds sing and dance until late, with big-headed cabezudo characters in the middle. It is a U.S. destination with no passport needed.
events.costNotes: Old San Juan rooms are pricey that weekend; consider Condado or Santurce.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Panama City, Panama","event":"Casco Viejo winter jazz festival (Jan)","note":"A different Latin city offering music, nightlife and warm weather."},{"destination":"Cartagena, Colombia","event":"Hay Festival Cartagena (late Jan/early Feb)","note":"Literary festival in a colorful colonial walled city."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands climb 272 steps to the Murugan temple, some carrying kavadi on pierced skin.
events.overview: Thaipusam honors Lord Murugan with a procession from Sri Mahamariamman Temple in the city to the Batu Caves, often with milk-pot carriers and devotees in trance. The sight is intense, devout and photogenic. Add Kuala Lumpur's food scene and Malaysia's islands or highlands.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground; fares are often best via Taipei, Seoul or Tokyo.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Singapore","event":"Thaipusam procession in Little India","note":"A smaller but organized version of the same festival."},{"destination":"Penang, Malaysia","event":"Thaipusam at Waterfall Hilltop Temple","note":"A second major Thaipusam celebration, plus Penang street food."}]

events.hook: A thousand torch-bearing 'Vikings' burn a longship in the Shetland dark.
events.overview: Held on the last Tuesday of January, Lerwick's fire festival features the Guizer Jarl's squad, a torchlit procession and the burning of a hand-built galley. Afterward, squads visit halls and party until dawn. Tickets to the halls are limited, but the procession and burning can be watched from the street.
events.costNotes: Includes a domestic flight or ferry from mainland Scotland; Shetland lodging is limited.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Edinburgh, Scotland","event":"Burns Night celebrations (Jan 25)","note":"Scottish poetry, haggis and whisky on the same week."},{"destination":"Tromsø, Norway","event":"Northern Lights season and Tromsø Sami events","note":"Another dark-season Nordic trip with natural spectacle."}]

events.hook: Bonhomme Carnaval rules a snowy old city of ice sculptures, night parades and caribou cocktails.
events.overview: One of the world's biggest winter carnivals fills the Plains of Abraham and Old Quebec with snow slides, ice canoe races and sculptures. It is walkable and French-speaking, with excellent restaurants and the Hôtel de Glace nearby. A short and relatively cheap flight from LAX.
events.costNotes: Cold-weather clothing and an Effigy pass are the main extras; hotel prices rise on carnival weekends.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Montreal, Canada","event":"Igloofest (Jan-Feb)","note":"Outdoor electronic music festival in the snow."},{"destination":"Ottawa, Canada","event":"Winterlude and Rideau Canal Skateway","note":"The world's largest naturally frozen skating rink."}]

events.hook: Masked balls, baroque costumes and gondola-lined canals in a winter-quiet Venice.
events.overview: Venice's Carnival is a centuries-old tradition of elaborate masks and costume contests in St Mark's Square. It ends on Shrove Tuesday (Feb 9, 2027). February crowds are thinner than summer, but Carnival weekends are busy.
events.costNotes: Carnival weekends push Venice lodging well above normal winter rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Viareggio, Italy","event":"Carnevale di Viareggio","note":"Giant satirical papier-mâché floats parade along the seafront."},{"destination":"Cádiz, Spain","event":"Carnaval de Cádiz","note":"Witty choirs and street satire in a very local Andalusian carnival."}]

events.event: Tết Nguyên Đán (Vietnamese Lunar New Year)
events.hook: Peach blossoms, fireworks over Hoan Kiem Lake and a whole nation heading home.
events.overview: Tết is Vietnam's most important holiday, with flower markets, family rituals and fireworks. Hanoi is the best place to feel it, with kumquat trees and peach blossoms everywhere. Many shops close for several days, but the city's atmosphere is memorable.
events.costNotes: Flights are pricey around Tết and some restaurants close for days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Singapore","event":"Chinese New Year River Hongbao","note":"Lantern installations, street light-ups and Chinatown feasts."},{"destination":"Hong Kong","event":"Lunar New Year Parade and fireworks","note":"Harbour fireworks, flower markets and a night parade."}]

events.hook: Building-sized snow sculptures glowing along Odori Park.
events.overview: Sapporo's week-long festival fills Odori Park with enormous snow and ice sculptures lit at night. Add Hokkaido ramen, crab and nearby powder skiing for a full winter trip. Dates are usually early February.
events.costNotes: Hotels fill fast during the festival, so book early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Yokote, Japan","event":"Yokote Kamakura Festival (Feb 15-16)","note":"Glowing snow huts where kids serve visitors amazake."},{"destination":"Quebec City, Canada","event":"Quebec Winter Carnival","note":"Ice palace, night parades and snow-sculpture contests."}]

events.hook: The planet's biggest party, with samba schools, mega-floats and street blocos from dawn to dawn.
events.overview: Rio's Carnival runs from the Friday before Ash Wednesday (Feb 10, 2027). The main draws are the Sambadrome parades of the top samba schools and hundreds of free street blocos. Book flights and lodging many months ahead, because prices peak.
events.costNotes: Carnival-week lodging runs at a steep premium and usually has minimum stays.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Salvador Carnival","note":"Trio elétrico trucks and axé music in a huge street party."},{"destination":"Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago","event":"Trinidad Carnival (Feb 8-9)","note":"Soca, steel pan and feathered costumes for a Caribbean take on the same vibe."}]

events.hook: Twenty thousand dancers in devil masks wind through a high-Andean mining city for 20 hours.
events.overview: Oruro's UNESCO-recognized carnival fuses Andean and Catholic traditions with the Diablada devil dance. The main Entrada procession is on the Saturday before Ash Wednesday. It is a rarely visited spectacle at about 3,700 m.
events.costNotes: Fly into La Paz and take a bus; seat tickets for the parade route are the main extra cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Puno, Peru","event":"Festividad de la Virgen de la Candelaria","note":"Lake Titicaca's huge folk-dance festival, with main days in early Feb."},{"destination":"Barranquilla, Colombia","event":"Carnaval de Barranquilla (Feb 6-9)","note":"Another UNESCO carnival, with cumbia and Garabato dances."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of ostrich-plumed Gilles dance through a small Belgian town in a UNESCO-listed ritual.
events.overview: Binche's carnival is a UNESCO Masterpiece of Intangible Heritage. On Shrove Tuesday the Gilles, in wax masks and huge ostrich-feather hats, drum and dance through the streets and throw blood oranges. It is far less touristy than Venice.
events.costNotes: Stay in Brussels or Mons, since Binche has little lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Basel, Switzerland","event":"Basler Fasnacht (starts Feb 15)","note":"A 72-hour Protestant carnival that starts at 4 a.m. with lantern-lit piping."},{"destination":"Cologne, Germany","event":"Cologne Carnival","note":"Huge costumed street party in the week before Ash Wednesday."}]

events.hook: Fanous lanterns, communal iftars and a city that comes alive after sunset.
events.overview: Ramadan is expected to begin around Feb 8, 2027, depending on moon sighting. Cairo is known for its lantern-hung streets, free iftar tables and late-night gatherings in Khan el-Khalili and around al-Hussein. Daytime is quieter, and visitors should respect fasting customs.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground; fares are moderate in the cool season.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Istanbul, Turkey","event":"Ramadan evenings in Sultanahmet","note":"Mosque-lit nights, drummers and iftar tents."},{"destination":"Fez, Morocco","event":"Ramadan in the medina","note":"Atmospheric evenings and traditional sweets."}]

events.hook: Half a million wildebeest calves are born in a few weeks, with predators close behind.
events.overview: In the southern Serengeti and Ndutu plains, wildebeest give birth to around 8,000 calves a day at peak, which draws lions, cheetahs and hyenas. Wildlife viewing is often outstanding and crowds are smaller than at the Mara river crossings. Exact peak timing shifts with the rains.
events.costNotes: Lodges and game drives dominate the budget; camps are sometimes sold as packages.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ngorongoro Crater, Tanzania","event":"Dense wildlife viewing in the crater","note":"Easy to combine with Ndutu for the same trip."},{"destination":"Etosha, Namibia","event":"Green-season wildlife and birding","note":"Quieter, with newborn animals at waterholes."}]

events.event: Pingxi Sky Lantern Festival / Lantern Festival
events.hook: Thousands of wish-bearing lanterns drift into the sky above a misty Taiwanese valley.
events.overview: The Lantern Festival ends the Lunar New Year on Feb 20, 2027. Pingxi's sky-lantern releases are the signature image, and the official Taiwan Lantern Festival adds large light installations elsewhere on the island. Taipei's night markets and hot springs round out the trip.
events.costNotes: Taipei is good value; exact lantern-event schedules are announced closer to the date.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Full-moon Lantern Night (around Feb 20)","note":"Silk lanterns and floating candles on the Thu Bon river."},{"destination":"Nagasaki, Japan","event":"Nagasaki Lantern Festival","note":"15,000 lanterns and Chinese-style parades in the port city, usually spanning Lunar New Year to the Lantern Festival."}]

events.event: Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade
events.eventDates: Approx. Feb 27 (festival runs for weeks before)
events.hook: One of the world's largest LGBTQ+ parades, in the middle of Sydney's summer.
events.overview: The Oxford Street parade closes the Mardi Gras festival with floats, dance and a huge party afterward. Late February is warm, so beaches and harbour days fit into the same trip. Dates are estimated from the usual last-Saturday pattern.
events.costNotes: Summer in Sydney has high lodging prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Adelaide Fringe (mid-Feb start)","note":"One of the world's largest arts festivals, with a mix of comedy and music."},{"destination":"Bay of Islands, New Zealand","event":"Waitangi Day (Feb 6)","note":"Commemorations at the treaty grounds, with waka and cultural performances."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands of newborn wildebeest and the predators hunting them on the southern Serengeti plains.
events.overview: The herds gather on the short-grass plains around Ndutu for calving, drawing lions, cheetahs and hyenas. Peak calving is in February but March still offers excellent action and fewer vehicles. Expect lodges or camps rather than Airbnbs.
events.costNotes: Safari camps, park fees and a Kilimanjaro or Arusha flight drive costs up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Masai Mara, Kenya","event":"Big cat and resident wildlife viewing","note":"The migration isn't there yet, but the Mara has strong wildlife year-round."},{"destination":"Okavango Delta, Botswana","event":"Green season wildlife and birding","note":"Quieter and cheaper than peak season, with lush landscapes."}]

events.hook: Friendly gray whales swim up to small boats and let you touch them.
events.overview: Gray whales migrate to the sheltered lagoons of Baja California Sur to give birth and nurse calves. San Ignacio is famous for its up-close encounters, and early March is among the best times for mothers and calves. It is a quiet, lesser-known trip close to LAX.
events.costNotes: Remote camps and eco-lodges dominate, so check what is included before comparing prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Magdalena Bay, Mexico","event":"Gray whale watching","note":"Easier access from Loreto or La Paz with a similar season."},{"destination":"Michoacán, Mexico","event":"Monarch butterfly overwintering","note":"Millions of monarchs cluster in the forests until the end of March."}]

events.hook: Daily firework-thunder mascletàs build to a night when whole streets of giant sculptures go up in flames.
events.overview: Valencia's UNESCO-listed festival fills the city with satirical papier-mâché monuments, brass bands, paella and nonstop pyrotechnics. The Nit del Foc fireworks and the La Cremà bonfires on the night of March 19 are the climax. The best window is March 15-19.
events.costNotes: Housing spikes sharply for the final five nights, and flights usually connect via Madrid or Europe.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Castellón de la Plana, Spain","event":"Fiesta de la Magdalena","note":"A smaller, local-feeling spring festival with parades and gaiatas lantern floats, usually mid to late March."},{"destination":"Sitges, Spain","event":"Spring street festivals and Mediterranean old town","note":"Seaside party-town energy with far fewer crowds than Valencia."}]

events.hook: Formula 1's lakeside season opener at Albert Park, with Melbourne's food and laneway culture on the side.
events.overview: The Australian GP is traditionally an early-season F1 event, and the 2027 date is estimated around March 7. Pair race weekend with the Great Ocean Road and Melbourne's coffee, wine and street-art scenes. Check final dates when the calendar is confirmed.
events.costNotes: Race tickets are the main extra cost and city rates spike for race weekend.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Adelaide, Australia","event":"Adelaide Fringe and WOMADelaide","note":"The Fringe runs through mid-March with world music festival WOMADelaide around the same time."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Pasifika Festival","note":"A free Pacific Islands culture festival that usually falls in March."}]

events.hook: Music, film and tech converge on Austin for nine days of showcases, tacos and sweaty parties.
events.overview: SXSW packs thousands of bands, premieres and panels into downtown venues, plus countless free unofficial shows. It is easy to reach from LAX and good for discovering new artists. Expect the city to be buzzing and booked.
events.costNotes: Housing is at its priciest of the year, and badges cost extra.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Miami, USA","event":"Ultra Music Festival and Miami Music Week","note":"Late March electronic music marathon, usually the last weekend of the month."},{"destination":"Buenos Aires, Argentina","event":"Lollapalooza Argentina","note":"A big multi-day festival typically in March."}]

events.hook: Holi is wildest where it began, with flower showers, Lathmar Holi, and clouds of colored powder.
events.overview: Braj, around Mathura, Vrindavan and Barsana, stages the most traditional Holi in India, with temple celebrations and Lathmar Holi, where women playfully beat men with sticks. Holi itself falls around March 22 and Holika Dahan bonfires the evening before. Combine with Delhi and Agra.
events.costNotes: Cheap on the ground, with flights to Delhi plus a drive or train to Mathura.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jaipur, India","event":"Holi and Elephant Festival","note":"A royal-city take on Holi, with a more tourist-friendly setup."},{"destination":"Kathmandu, Nepal","event":"Fagu Purnima (Holi)","note":"Colorful celebrations in Durbar Square and the Himalayan foothills."}]

events.hook: Go to the source for St Paddy's: a four-day parade-and-pub spectacle in the city that invented the green-beer cliché.
events.overview: The national festival has a huge parade through the center, plus trad music sessions, street theatre, a food market and a literary program. Combine it with day trips to Wicklow or the Dingle coast. Dates are estimated around March 17.
events.costNotes: Dublin accommodation is expensive and peaks around March 17.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Galway, Ireland","event":"St Patrick's Week","note":"A more intimate parade and a strong music scene on the west coast."},{"destination":"Savannah, USA","event":"St Patrick's Day Parade","note":"One of the biggest St Patrick's celebrations in the US, much closer to LAX."}]

events.hook: Silk Road spring: blue-tiled Registan Square hosts folk music, wrestling, and giant cauldrons of sumalak.
events.overview: Navruz, the Persian New Year at the spring equinox, is Uzbekistan's biggest holiday. Samarkand marks it with concerts, horse games, craft fairs and communal sumalak cooking. It makes a good low-profile alternative to better-known festivals.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Istanbul or Dubai, and ground costs are low.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Shiraz, Iran","event":"Nowruz at Persepolis","note":"Spectacular heritage setting, though travel advisories and visa rules need checking carefully."},{"destination":"Bukhara, Uzbekistan","event":"Navruz celebrations","note":"A compact old city that pairs well with Samarkand."}]

events.hook: Tokyo's parks turn pink for about a week, and the whole city drinks tea and sake beneath the petals.
events.overview: First bloom and full bloom depend on the weather, but Tokyo typically peaks in the last week of March or the first days of April. Rent a boat on the Chidorigafuchi moat, picnic in Ueno or Shinjuku Gyoen, and add Kyoto and Hiroshima if time allows. Book early and keep your dates flexible.
events.costNotes: This is Japan's priciest season, and rail passes or a Kyoto side trip would add to the total.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Cherry blossoms at Philosopher's Path and Maruyama Park","note":"Often peaks a few days after Tokyo, with temples and gardens in bloom."},{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Early cherry blossoms","note":"Blossoms usually arrive in early April, so this suits the very end of the trip window."}]

events.hook: Candlelit processions of hooded penitents and gilded floats wind through orange-scented streets, and Easter falls on March 28 this year.
events.overview: Seville's Holy Week is the most intense in Spain, with dozens of brotherhoods carrying elaborate pasos through the old town, accompanied by saetas and drum corps. Madrugá, the overnight procession on Good Friday morning, is unforgettable. Orange blossom is also at its peak.
events.costNotes: Holy Week commands premium rates, and nearly everything near the processions books out months ahead.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Antigua, Guatemala","event":"Semana Santa","note":"Famous for sawdust carpets (alfombras) and a colonial backdrop, with a good early-spring price point."},{"destination":"Málaga, Spain","event":"Semana Santa","note":"Huge tronos and a lively atmosphere, with beaches close by."}]

events.hook: Runners cross the Sahara carrying everything they need in a six-stage, self-supported ultramarathon.
events.overview: The Marathon des Sables covers about 250 km of dunes, dry riverbeds and rocky plains in southeastern Morocco. Spectators can watch from Merzouga and nearby desert camps, and pair it with camel treks and dune nights. Dates are approximate, so confirm with the organizers.
events.costNotes: Includes desert transfers and guided excursions rather than race entry.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Marrakech, Morocco","event":"Spring souk and garden season","note":"Easy to combine with a desert leg."},{"destination":"Wadi Rum, Jordan","event":"Desert camps and trekking in spring","note":"A similar desert-adventure vibe."}]

events.hook: Azaleas, Amen Corner and golf's most exclusive ticket.
events.overview: The Masters is played at Augusta National Golf Club in Georgia each April, with practice rounds earlier in the week. Tickets are hard to get, through lottery or resale. Even without them, Augusta fills with watch parties and golf culture.
events.costNotes: Masters-week rentals and ticket resale make this the priciest event here.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Savannah, United States","event":"Spring azalea and garden season","note":"A cheaper, historic base within driving distance."},{"destination":"Hilton Head, United States","event":"RBC Heritage golf tournament","note":"Another PGA event in the same region around the same time."}]

events.hook: A week of flamenco dresses, sherry and horse-drawn carriages in a temporary city of casetas.
events.overview: The Feria begins with the Monday-night lighting of thousands of lanterns (the Alumbrao). It continues with dancing, sevillanas, fino sherry and the Real de la Feria fairground. Dates are estimated from the Easter calendar, so confirm them.
events.costNotes: Feria week pushes Seville lodging to its yearly peak.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Feria del Caballo (typically early May)","note":"Horse-focused fair with sherry bodega visits."},{"destination":"Córdoba, Spain","event":"Cruces de Mayo and patio season","note":"Late spring brings flower-filled patios and street celebrations."}]

events.hook: Thailand's New Year turns an entire moated city into one giant, joyful water fight.
events.overview: Songkran marks the traditional Thai New Year with temple visits, sand pagoda building and the famous citywide soaking. Chiang Mai has the most intense celebration, centered on the old city moat. Expect the festivities to run a few days beyond the official dates.
events.costNotes: Peak-week flights and old-city stays cost more, but food and local transport are cheap.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luang Prabang, Laos","event":"Pi Mai Lao (Apr 14-16)","note":"A gentler Lao New Year with processions, Buddha-washing and water blessings."},{"destination":"Siem Reap, Cambodia","event":"Khmer New Year (Apr 14-16)","note":"Traditional games and celebrations near Angkor."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest annual marathon, run on Patriots' Day with crowds lining all 26.2 miles.
events.overview: The race runs from Hopkinton to Boylston Street. Spectators can cheer at Wellesley's famous Scream Tunnel or near Heartbreak Hill. Boston is also good for history, seafood and a Red Sox game on Patriots' Day.
events.costNotes: Race-week hotel and rental prices are high in Boston.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"London, United Kingdom","event":"London Marathon (late April)","note":"Another major marathon, with a big charity atmosphere."},{"destination":"Washington, D.C., United States","event":"National Cherry Blossom Festival","note":"Blossoms usually peak between late March and early April."}]

events.hook: Two weekends of jazz, brass bands, gospel and crawfish at the Fair Grounds.
events.overview: Jazz Fest fills the Fair Grounds with stages of music and a large Creole and Cajun food lineup. Evening shows around the city add to the program. Dates and lineup are typically announced in winter.
events.costNotes: Weekend festival tickets and evening shows add up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Memphis, United States","event":"Memphis in May","note":"Barbecue and music events through May."},{"destination":"Lafayette, United States","event":"Festival International de Louisiane (late April)","note":"A free Francophone music festival in Cajun country."}]

events.hook: Castle moats turn pink with fallen petals while northern Japan hits peak sakura weeks after Tokyo and Kyoto are done.
events.overview: Hirosaki Park has about 2,600 cherry trees around a original wooden castle, with night illuminations and food stalls. The moat covered in floating petals (hanaikada) is the highlight. Dates follow the bloom, so check forecasts closer to the time.
events.costNotes: Includes a domestic Tokyo-Aomori leg or Shinkansen and Golden Week-adjacent lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Matsumae, Japan","event":"Matsumae Cherry Blossom Festival","note":"Hokkaido's southern tip blooms late April to May with over 10,000 trees."},{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Sanno Matsuri (Apr 14-15)","note":"Ornate festival floats parade through a preserved Edo-era town."}]

events.hook: Epitaph processions, brass bands and clay pots hurled from balconies on Holy Saturday.
events.overview: Corfu is known for its Easter customs, including Venetian-era processions with local philharmonic bands. On Holy Saturday morning residents smash large pots from windows (the botides). Orthodox Easter Sunday is May 2, 2027, with lamb roasts across the island.
events.costNotes: Flights to Corfu usually connect through Athens or another European hub.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Patmos, Greece","event":"Holy Week at the Cave of the Apocalypse","note":"A quieter, deeply devotional Easter on a pilgrimage island."},{"destination":"Jerusalem, Israel","event":"Orthodox Holy Fire ceremony (Holy Saturday, May 1)","note":"Pilgrims fill the Church of the Holy Sepulchre."}]

events.hook: A pre-dawn vigil in the dark, then marching veterans and descendants through the city.
events.overview: Anzac Day honors Australian and New Zealand service members. In Sydney, crowds gather at Martin Place before dawn and a large march follows later in the morning. It is a solemn, moving national occasion, and autumn weather is mild.
events.costNotes: Long-haul fares and Sydney lodging dominate the budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Wellington, New Zealand","event":"Anzac Day Dawn Service at the National War Memorial","note":"A large, atmospheric service in the capital."},{"destination":"Melbourne, Australia","event":"Melbourne International Comedy Festival (ends mid-April)","note":"A big comedy festival with a very different mood."}]

events.hook: The whole city dresses in orange, floods the canals with boats and turns the streets into a flea market.
events.overview: King's Day celebrates the Dutch monarch's birthday with free markets (vrijmarkt), canal parties and open-air music. King's Night on April 26 starts the party. Late April is also tulip season, so you can pair it with the fields and Keukenhof.
events.costNotes: Amsterdam lodging spikes sharply around King's Day.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lisse, Netherlands","event":"Keukenhof and the Bollenstreek tulip fields","note":"Peak bloom usually runs mid-April to early May."},{"destination":"Utrecht, Netherlands","event":"King's Day with a calmer, canal-side feel","note":"A cheaper, less crowded alternative."}]

events.hook: Two minutes of thoroughbred racing wrapped in mint juleps, giant hats and a century and a half of Southern pageantry.
events.overview: The 153rd Kentucky Derby runs at Churchill Downs on the first Saturday of May. Derby week also brings the Oaks, fireworks, and bourbon trail tastings across Kentucky. Book early, because hotels and tickets sell out months ahead.
events.costNotes: Derby-week lodging carries a steep premium and the experiential figure includes general admission and bourbon-trail transport.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Baltimore, United States","event":"Preakness Stakes (mid-May)","note":"The second jewel of the Triple Crown, with a more relaxed infield party."},{"destination":"Memphis, United States","event":"Memphis in May festival","note":"Beale Street Music Festival and the World Championship Barbecue Cooking Contest fill the riverfront."}]

events.hook: Damask rose harvest in the Dades Valley, with parades, folk music and a crowned Rose Queen.
events.overview: Every spring the Dades Valley celebrates its rose harvest with a village moussem. Expect folk troupes, a rose queen procession, and stalls selling rose water and oils. It makes a good anchor for a Atlas Mountains and Ouarzazate road trip, and few foreign visitors know about it.
events.costNotes: Flights go to Marrakech or Ouarzazate, with a rental car or driver for the valley.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Fes, Morocco","event":"Fes Festival of World Sacred Music (typically late spring, verify dates)","note":"Spiritual music in a medieval medina setting."},{"destination":"Kazanlak, Bulgaria","event":"Rose Festival (early June)","note":"Same rose-harvest vibe in Bulgaria's Rose Valley, just after May ends."}]

events.hook: Red-carpet glamour on the Croisette, with the world's best new cinema premiering by the sea.
events.overview: The Cannes Film Festival is the biggest event in world cinema. The main screenings are industry and invitation only, but the red-carpet arrivals, beach screenings and yacht-lined atmosphere are open to anyone who comes. Dates are estimated from the usual mid-May slot.
events.costNotes: Festival-fortnight rentals are the biggest expense, and staying in Nice or Antibes would cut costs sharply.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Nice, France","event":"Riviera base with day trips to Cannes","note":"Cheaper lodging and a 30-minute train to the festival."},{"destination":"New York, United States","event":"Tribeca Festival (early June)","note":"Film-festival energy in a big city, though it falls just after May."}]

events.hook: Bun towers, floating children on stilts and a midnight scramble up a tower of sacred buns on a car-free island.
events.overview: This Taoist island festival, held around Buddha's Birthday, features a parade of "floating" children in costume and lion dances. It climaxes with a bun-tower scramble at Pak Tai Temple. It is a short ferry ride from Central, and the island's seafood is excellent.
events.costNotes: Hong Kong lodging is pricey, so a Kowloon base with a ferry out to the island keeps costs down.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Seoul, South Korea","event":"Lotus Lantern Festival (the weekend before Buddha's Birthday)","note":"A huge lantern parade through central Seoul, probably May 7-9."},{"destination":"Macau","event":"Drunken Dragon Festival (Buddha's Birthday)","note":"A quirky traditional dance on the streets of the old town."}]

events.hook: A million pilgrims in flamenco dress, horse carts and oxen carts converge on a sandy village in Doñana.
events.overview: Each Pentecost, brotherhoods from across Andalusia walk or ride to the shrine of the Virgin of El Rocío. The village has no paved streets, and the pilgrims camp, sing and dance for days. The climax comes at dawn on Pentecost Monday, when the Virgin is carried out of the shrine.
events.costNotes: Stay in Seville or Huelva rather than the village itself, which has almost no lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Córdoba, Spain","event":"Festival de los Patios (early-mid May)","note":"Private courtyards open to visitors and covered in flowers."},{"destination":"Jerez de la Frontera, Spain","event":"Feria del Caballo (usually May, verify dates)","note":"Horse parades, sherry tents and flamenco."}]

events.hook: A 500-person Heian-era court procession winds from the Imperial Palace to Kamo shrines.
events.overview: Aoi Matsuri is one of Kyoto's three great festivals, with ox-drawn carriages and courtiers in layered silk robes decked in hollyhock leaves. It is held every May 15 and moves to the next day if it rains. Pair it with Kyoto's quiet early-summer temples and gardens.
events.costNotes: Reserved seating for the procession costs extra, but the route can be watched free from the street.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tokyo, Japan","event":"Kanda Matsuri (main festival in odd years, mid-May)","note":"A huge portable-shrine parade held only in odd years."},{"destination":"Fukuoka, Japan","event":"Hakata Dontaku (May 3-4)","note":"Golden Week street parades if you want an early-May trip."}]

events.hook: A whole nation in folk dress, with children's parades past the Royal Palace and ice cream for everyone.
events.overview: Norway's national day is one of the world's friendliest. Tens of thousands in bunad costumes parade through Oslo and wave to the royal family on the palace balcony. The day also brings brass bands, hot dogs and picnics.
events.costNotes: Norway is expensive across the board, especially restaurant meals.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bergen, Norway","event":"Syttende Mai plus Festspillene (festival season starts)","note":"Known for its huge children's parade through the harbor-front streets."},{"destination":"Hamburg, Germany","event":"Hafengeburtstag (port birthday, early May)","note":"A big harbor festival that falls earlier in the month."}]

events.hook: The island glows with thousands of paper lanterns, pandals and free food stalls for the Buddha's birthday.
events.overview: Vesak is Sri Lanka's most important Buddhist celebration, held on the May full moon. Streets fill with lantern displays, illuminated pandals telling Jataka tales, and dansal (free food stalls). Colombo's Gangaramaya temple and Kandy's lakeside are especially lively.
events.costNotes: Flights to Colombo usually connect via the Gulf or Asia, and local costs are low.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Borobudur, Indonesia","event":"Waisak at Borobudur (lantern release)","note":"Monks walk to the great temple at dawn and release lanterns at night."},{"destination":"Bangkok, Thailand","event":"Visakha Bucha candlelit processions","note":"Temples hold evening candlelit processions with chanting."}]

events.hook: Light sculptures, projections and music turn the harbour into the southern hemisphere's biggest light show.
events.overview: Vivid Sydney lights up the Opera House sails, Circular Quay and The Rocks with large-scale projections for three weeks of southern winter nights. It also runs a music program and ideas talks. The dates are estimated from the usual late-May start.
events.costNotes: Sydney lodging peaks during Vivid, and booking a few months ahead helps.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hobart, Australia","event":"Dark Mofo (mid-June)","note":"A moody winter arts festival that falls just after May."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Auckland Writers Festival (typically mid-May)","note":"A literary option with a milder city vibe."}]

events.hook: Over 300,000 fans watch 33 cars at 230 mph on Memorial Day weekend at the Brickyard.
events.overview: The Indy 500 is the world's largest single-day sporting event, held the Sunday before Memorial Day. Carb Day on Friday and the milk-drinking, wreath-wearing ceremony add to the spectacle. Memorial Day weekend is a sellout, so plan far ahead.
events.costNotes: Race-weekend lodging spikes, and the experiential figure includes grandstand tickets.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Charlotte, United States","event":"Coca-Cola 600 (NASCAR, same Sunday)","note":"A long race you can pair with the same weekend."},{"destination":"Monte Carlo, Monaco","event":"Monaco Grand Prix (typically late May or early June, verify the 2027 date)","note":"Street racing through the principality."}]

events.event: Tuen Ng Dragon Boat Festival and International Dragon Boat Races
events.hook: Thundering drums and racing dragon boats in Victoria Harbour on a 2,000-year-old holiday.
events.overview: Tuen Ng falls on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month. Crews race decorated dragon boats at Stanley, Sha Tin and Tsim Sha Tsui while locals eat zongzi. It is a loud, colourful mix of sport and folklore, and combines easily with Hong Kong's dim sum and harbour-side sightseeing.
events.costNotes: June is hot and humid, so flights and hotels are moderate; Hong Kong lodging is pricey for its size.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gangneung, South Korea","event":"Gangneung Danoje Festival (UNESCO-listed, held on the same lunar date)","note":"Shamanic rites, traditional wrestling and a huge market on the same lunar holiday."},{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Dragon Boat Festival races at Dajia Riverside","note":"Big races, street food and easy day trips on the same holiday."}]

events.hook: Tens of thousands of dancers in neon costumes take over Sapporo's streets in a joyful five-day contest.
events.overview: Sapporo's YOSAKOI Soran blends Kochi's yosakoi dance with Hokkaido's Soran folk song. Teams of up to 150 dancers perform on Odori Park and street stages across the city. It falls in Hokkaido's pleasant early summer, before the July crowds, and is far less crowded with foreign visitors than Kyoto or Tokyo festivals.
events.costNotes: Flights usually connect via Tokyo; Sapporo hotels fill up during festival days.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Kanazawa, Japan","event":"Hyakumangoku Festival (early June)","note":"A samurai-style procession through a beautifully preserved castle town; check exact dates."},{"destination":"Furano, Japan","event":"Early lavender bloom in Hokkaido","note":"Fields start to colour in late June; peak is July, so treat it as an add-on."}]

events.hook: Hypercars hammer through the night in the world's most famous endurance race.
events.overview: The 24 Hours of Le Mans is the crown jewel of endurance racing, with top-class hypercars sharing the Circuit de la Sarthe with GT cars and amateur drivers. The campsites, the Ferris wheel and the sunrise finish are as much a part of it as the racing. Race week is a motorsport festival with a parade, a car club scene and village-style partying.
events.costNotes: Lodging around Le Mans is scarce and priced up in race week; grandstand or general admission tickets are included in the experiential estimate.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Fête de la Musique (Jun 21)","note":"Free concerts on every corner; Le Mans is about an hour away by TGV."},{"destination":"Isle of Man, UK","event":"Isle of Man TT (late May to mid-June)","note":"Road racing at extreme speed through villages, if you want a second motorsport pilgrimage."}]

events.hook: The world's oldest and largest ultramarathon: 90 km between Durban and Pietermaritzburg.
events.overview: Roughly 20,000 runners tackle the Comrades, a 12-hour test on the roads of KwaZulu-Natal with a famously emotional finish. Spectators line the route with braais and cheering that goes on from before dawn to the 12-hour cut-off gun. Durban has warm winter weather, good beaches and curry, so it works for supporters as well as runners.
events.costNotes: South African winter is low season for accommodation, so lodging and food are cheap; flights are long and connect via Johannesburg or Doha.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hermanus, South Africa","event":"Southern right whales arrive (June onwards)","note":"The first whales appear along the cliff path this month; the peak is later in winter."},{"destination":"Fez, Morocco","event":"Fes Festival of World Sacred Music (usually late May-June)","note":"Check 2027 dates; spiritual concerts in medina courtyards."}]

events.event: Festa de São João do Porto
events.hook: A whole city tapping strangers on the head with plastic hammers and grilling sardines until dawn.
events.overview: On the night of Jun 23, Porto's streets fill with grilled sardines, basil plants, leek tickling and sky lanterns, then a midnight fireworks show over the Douro. The party goes on until sunrise on the beach at Foz. It is one of Europe's best street parties and entirely local rather than touristy.
events.costNotes: Midsummer is high season, and São João weekend is the busiest night for Porto accommodation.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Braga, Portugal","event":"São João de Braga (Jun 23-24)","note":"Smaller, with a distinctive parade, bonfires and Minho folk traditions."},{"destination":"Lisbon, Portugal","event":"Festas de Lisboa / Santo António (June)","note":"Neighbourhood arraiais with sardines, music and the Jun 12-13 Santo António night."}]

events.hook: The Inca winter solstice ceremony is recreated at Sacsayhuamán in front of tens of thousands of spectators.
events.overview: Inti Raymi begins at the Qorikancha temple, moves to the Plaza de Armas, and ends with a staged sun ritual among the Sacsayhuamán ruins. Cusco's festive week brings parades, street food and music, and the city is a natural base for Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley. June is the dry season, with clear skies and cold nights.
events.costNotes: Peak dry-season prices; seats in the Sacsayhuamán stands and Machu Picchu entry should be purchased early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"La Paz, Bolivia","event":"Aymara New Year at Tiwanaku (Jun 21)","note":"Sunrise ceremony at the temple ruins on the solstice."},{"destination":"Otavalo, Ecuador","event":"Inti Raymi / San Juan festivities (late June)","note":"Indigenous communities celebrate with music, dance and ritual bathing."}]

events.hook: The first Women's World Cup in South America kicks off in the country that lives for football.
events.overview: Brazil hosts the 2027 tournament in eight cities, including Rio, São Paulo and Salvador, with the final expected at Rio's Maracanã. The group stage is in late June, so travellers can sample several host cities and fan zones. It is the first time the tournament is held in South America.
events.costNotes: Match tickets and Rio lodging are inflated during the tournament; domestic flights between host cities are extra.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Caruaru, Brazil","event":"São João festas juninas (all June)","note":"Brazil's biggest forró and bonfire party in the northeast, running through late June."},{"destination":"Parintins, Brazil","event":"Parintins Folklore Festival (last weekend of June)","note":"Giant Amazonian opera-style bull-folklore contest, reached by boat or plane."}]

events.eventDates: Jun 25 (public holiday; events run for about two weeks)
events.hook: New Zealand welcomes the rising of the Matariki star cluster with fireworks, light shows and feasts.
events.overview: Matariki marks the Māori New Year when the Pleiades reappears before dawn in midwinter. Auckland holds a festival of kapa haka, storytelling, night lights and hāngī, and the Sky Tower and harbour are lit up. It is an authentic, growing cultural celebration, and Auckland is a good base for Waiheke wineries, volcano walks and Northland.
events.costNotes: Winter is low season in New Zealand, so lodging is relatively cheap; flights are long.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Wellington, New Zealand","event":"Matariki Ahi Kā fireworks and Te Papa events","note":"Fireworks over the harbour and a major Te Papa programme."},{"destination":"Queenstown, New Zealand","event":"Queenstown Winter Festival (late June)","note":"Snow sports, fireworks and street events for the same holiday period."}]

events.hook: Maypoles, flower crowns and folk dancing in nearly 24-hour daylight beside Lake Siljan.
events.overview: Midsummer Eve in Dalarna is Sweden's most traditional celebration. Villages raise and dance around maypoles, with fiddlers, folk dress, herring, new potatoes and strawberries on the table. Leksand's church boats and the Siljan lakeside offer some of the most authentic celebrations in the country.
events.costNotes: Sweden is expensive; the figures assume a stay split between Stockholm and Dalarna and a rental car.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Tallinn, Estonia","event":"Jaanipäev (Midsummer, Jun 23-24)","note":"Huge bonfires, wreaths and a national holiday atmosphere."},{"destination":"Riga, Latvia","event":"Līgo / Jāņi (Jun 23-24)","note":"Oak-leaf crowns, folk songs and bonfires across the countryside."}]

events.hook: Tahiti's biggest cultural festival, with dance and drumming competitions, canoe races and traditional sports.
events.overview: Heiva i Tahiti is a competition of dance troupes, singers and drummers, plus outrigger races and stone lifting. It is not a mass-tourism event, and the islands are at their driest in July. Combine it with Moorea or Bora Bora.
events.costNotes: Prices in French Polynesia are high, and the dates should be checked once the official programme is out.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Rarotonga, Cook Islands","event":"Te Maeva Nui","note":"Island dance and music celebration around late July to early August."},{"destination":"Oahu, USA","event":"Prince Lot Hula Festival","note":"Hula festival in mid-July at Moanalua Gardens."}]

events.hook: Kyoto's month-long festival wheels towering floats through the old city.
events.overview: One of Japan's three great festivals, Gion Matsuri has been held for over a thousand years. The evening Yoiyama nights before each float parade are the best time to walk the lantern-lit streets in a yukata.
events.costNotes: July is hot and humid, so hotels are cheaper than in spring or autumn, but the parade weekends fill up.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Fukuoka, Japan","event":"Hakata Gion Yamakasa","note":"Teams race multi-ton floats at dawn on Jul 15, with the festival running from Jul 1."},{"destination":"Soma, Japan","event":"Soma Nomaoi","note":"Samurai horseback festival in late July."}]

events.hook: Ten days of chuckwagon races, bucking broncs and free pancake breakfasts in the self-styled Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth.
events.overview: The world's biggest rodeo takes over Calgary with the chuckwagon races, a huge midway, concerts and a parade that opens the festival. Add a few days in the nearby Rockies for Banff and Lake Louise.
events.costNotes: Stampede week pushes lodging up sharply, so book early; costs include rodeo tickets and a rental car for a Banff side trip.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Cheyenne, USA","event":"Cheyenne Frontier Days","note":"Mid-to-late July rodeo and country-music week, a cheaper and shorter trip from LAX."},{"destination":"Quebec City, Canada","event":"Festival d'été de Québec","note":"Big-name outdoor concerts across the old city in early-to-mid July."}]

events.hook: The Tour de France opens in Barcelona, then rolls through the Pyrenees and on to the Champs-Élysées.
events.overview: Barcelona hosts the Grand Départ, with the team presentation and the opening stages drawing huge crowds. Pair the start with the Catalan Pyrenees or follow the race into France for a mountain stage.
events.costNotes: Start-weekend accommodation in Barcelona is very tight and will carry a premium.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Paris, France","event":"Bastille Day and Tour finish","note":"Jul 14 military parade and fireworks, with the race finale on the Champs-Élysées on Jul 25."},{"destination":"Montreux, Switzerland","event":"Montreux Jazz Festival","note":"Lakeside concerts in the first half of July with Alpine scenery."}]

events.hook: A rocket at noon starts nine days of white-and-red revelry and the daily bull run.
events.overview: Pamplona's fiesta opens with the Chupinazo on Jul 6 and ends with the Pobre de Mí candlelit farewell on Jul 14. Beyond the encierros there are processions, giants and dancers, pintxos and all-night street parties.
events.costNotes: Pamplona prices peak during the fiesta, so many travelers base in San Sebastián or Logroño.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Avignon, France","event":"Festival d'Avignon","note":"Three weeks of theatre and dance in the Papal city through most of July."},{"destination":"Siena, Italy","event":"Palio di Siena","note":"Bareback horse race around the Piazza del Campo on Jul 2."}]

events.hook: Herds of wildebeest plunge into the crocodile-filled Mara River.
events.overview: From July, over a million wildebeest and zebra reach the Mara River and begin the dramatic crossings. Timing varies from year to year, so build in several days of game drives for the best chance of seeing one.
events.costNotes: Experiential cost covers park fees, game drives and a Nairobi flight; peak-season camps book out early.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Serengeti, Tanzania","event":"Northern Serengeti Mara River crossings","note":"The same herds cross on the Tanzanian side, usually a little later."},{"destination":"Hermanus, South Africa","event":"Southern right whale season","note":"Whales are visible from shore from July, with the town's whale festival later in the year."}]

events.hook: Wrestling, archery and steppe horse racing in Mongolia's national festival.
events.overview: Naadam's "three manly games" are wrestling, archery and horse racing, opened with a ceremony in the capital's national stadium. Extend the trip with a ger-camp stay in the steppe, where village Naadams are smaller and more local.
events.costNotes: Experiential cost includes a guided steppe trip and ger-camp nights.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Boryeong, South Korea","event":"Boryeong Mud Festival","note":"Mud pools and beach parties in mid-to-late July."},{"destination":"Xichang, China","event":"Yi Torch Festival","note":"Bonfire and wrestling festival around late July; the exact date follows the lunar calendar."}]

events.hook: The world's best-known electronic festival, held over two weekends in a Belgian park.
events.overview: Tomorrowland's fairytale stages, fireworks and top DJs draw roughly 400,000 fans from around the world. Base in Antwerp, Brussels or Ghent and add the medieval cities of Flanders.
events.costNotes: Includes a festival ticket of roughly $350-450; confirm the 2027 dates once announced.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Ghent, Belgium","event":"Gentse Feesten","note":"Ten days of free street music and theatre in mid-to-late July."},{"destination":"Roskilde, Denmark","event":"Roskilde Festival","note":"Large Nordic music festival that runs from late June into early July."}]

events.hook: Delegations from Oaxaca's eight regions dance on a hilltop amphitheatre in their traditional dress.
events.overview: The Guelaguetza is held on the two Mondays after Jul 16 at the Cerro del Fortín amphitheatre. The city around it fills with mezcal tastings, mole feasts, parades and calendas, and it is a good base for the Zapotec ruins of Monte Albán.
events.costNotes: Amphitheatre seats are ticketed, so book those early; Oaxaca stays affordable.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salvador, Brazil","event":"Dois de Julho Independence parade","note":"Bahia's big street parade on Jul 2 with Afro-Brazilian music."},{"destination":"Lima, Peru","event":"Fiestas Patrias","note":"Peruvian independence celebrations on Jul 28-29, with food and parades."}]

events.hook: Japan's biggest outdoor music festival, held on a ski resort in the mountains.
events.overview: Fuji Rock is a three-day festival at Naeba Ski Resort known for its lineup, clean grounds and forest stages. Add Tokyo or the Niigata onsen towns to the trip.
events.costNotes: Includes a 3-day ticket of roughly $400 and the shinkansen from Tokyo.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Osaka, Japan","event":"Tenjin Matsuri","note":"River boat procession and fireworks on Jul 24-25."},{"destination":"Furano, Japan","event":"Hokkaido lavender peak","note":"Fields at peak bloom in mid-to-late July, a calmer alternative."}]

events.hook: A harvest festival that ends in a full-costume carnival road march.
events.overview: Crop Over marks the end of the sugar-cane harvest and builds to Kadooment Day on the first Monday in August, with thousands of costumed revelers dancing to soca. It comes after weeks of calypso and soca contests and fetes. Stay on after for Barbados' beaches and rum shacks.
events.costNotes: Costume packages cost extra, and beach-side lodging fills up quickly.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Grenada","event":"Spicemas Carnival","note":"Pre-dawn J'ouvert and Monday-Tuesday parades in mid-August."},{"destination":"Toronto, Canada","event":"Toronto Caribbean Carnival","note":"North America's largest Caribbean carnival, with the Grand Parade at the start of August."}]

events.hook: Giant glowing warrior floats roll through the streets while dancers in bells leap beside them.
events.overview: One of Tohoku's great summer fire-and-light festivals, with illuminated paper lantern floats on parade each night. Anyone can join the haneto dancers in rented costume. The week ends with a fireworks-and-float finale on the harbor.
events.costNotes: Aomori hotels fill up months ahead, so cost assumes booking early.
