events.alternates: [{"destination":"Hirosaki, Japan","event":"Hirosaki Neputa Festival","note":"Fan-shaped lantern floats, with a more intimate castle-town feel."},{"destination":"Akita, Japan","event":"Akita Kanto Festival","note":"Performers balance towering lantern poles on their foreheads and hips."}]

events.hook: The longest total eclipse of the century lands on Europe's doorstep, and the Andalusian coast is in the path.
events.overview: On 2 August 2027 the Moon's shadow crosses southern Spain, with more than four minutes of totality along the Cádiz and Málaga coasts in the late-morning sun. Sky, sea and whitewashed towns make a dramatic backdrop. Pair it with tapas, sherry and beaches either side.
events.costNotes: Eclipse-week lodging in the path of totality sells out and carries steep premiums.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Luxor, Egypt","event":"Total solar eclipse, about 6 minutes of totality","note":"Longest totality on land, with the temples of the Nile as a backdrop."},{"destination":"Tangier, Morocco","event":"Total solar eclipse over the Strait of Gibraltar","note":"Same eclipse, with a cheaper stay and a very different culture."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest arts festival turns a whole medieval city into one giant stage.
events.overview: Thousands of comedy, theatre, music and cabaret shows run for most of the month in pubs, churches and basements. It overlaps the Military Tattoo and the International Festival. Late nights and unpredictable weather come with the territory.
events.costNotes: Edinburgh's peak-festival rental prices are among the highest in the UK.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Salzburg, Austria","event":"Salzburg Festival","note":"Classical opera and drama in a baroque setting."},{"destination":"Budapest, Hungary","event":"Sziget Festival","note":"A week-long island music festival on the Danube, usually mid-August."}]

events.hook: Japan's largest dance festival: 100,000 dancers chanting 'the fools dance, the fools watch'.
events.overview: Part of the Obon holiday, Awa Odori fills Tokushima's streets with dancing groups, called ren, in indigo yukata, to a samisen and drum beat. Visitors can join in for free at open-participation spots. It is more raucous and less touristed than Kyoto's Obon rites.
events.costNotes: Fly into Osaka and take the bus to Tokushima; Obon week is expensive.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gujo Hachiman, Japan","event":"Gujo Odori all-night dancing","note":"Four nights of all-night dancing in a river town, at their peak Aug 13-16."},{"destination":"Kyoto, Japan","event":"Gozan no Okuribi","note":"Giant bonfires on the hillsides send ancestral spirits off on Aug 16."}]

events.hook: Highland tribes in feathers, clay and face paint gather in one of the world's most extraordinary cultural displays.
events.overview: Dozens of tribes from across PNG's highlands perform sing-sings in full ceremonial dress. It is one of the most remarkable and least-visited cultural gatherings anywhere. Plan carefully, since travel logistics and security need advance planning.
events.costNotes: Few lodging options, and guides and transfers are the main expense; check the show dates locally.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gove Peninsula, Australia","event":"Garma Festival","note":"A Yolngu cultural gathering in Arnhem Land around the start of August."},{"destination":"Cairns, Australia","event":"Cairns Indigenous Art Fair","note":"Contemporary Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander art, usually in mid-August."}]

events.hook: The world's largest Native American art market takes over the historic plaza.
events.overview: Over 1,000 artists from more than 200 tribes sell jewelry, pottery, textiles and sculpture. Fashion shows, contests and the early-morning lines for top booths add to the buzz. The city's adobe architecture and green-chile food scene round out the trip.
events.costNotes: A cheap flight is offset by very high Indian Market weekend lodging.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Crow Agency, USA","event":"Crow Fair","note":"A large powwow and rodeo in Montana, usually in mid-to-late August."},{"destination":"Gallup, USA","event":"Gallup Inter-Tribal Ceremonial","note":"A long-running Native American gathering with dances, rodeo and arts, usually in early-to-mid August."}]

events.hook: A temporary city of 70,000 builds in the Nevada desert, then burns a giant effigy.
events.overview: Nine days of art cars, experimental installations, camps and radical self-expression on the Black Rock Playa. Participants must bring everything they need, including water, shelter and food. A night at the Temple is the unforgettable part.
events.costNotes: Reno flight or car, plus ticket, gear and camp costs, with no Airbnb in the usual sense.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sturgis, USA","event":"Sturgis Motorcycle Rally","note":"A massive motorcycle gathering in South Dakota in early-to-mid August."},{"destination":"San Francisco, USA","event":"Outside Lands","note":"A big music and food festival in Golden Gate Park in early August."}]

events.hook: Europe's biggest street party, with steel bands, sound systems and jerk chicken.
events.overview: Over a million people crowd Notting Hill for two days of Caribbean music, costumes and floats on the August bank holiday weekend. Sunday is family day, and Monday is the big parade. Wander the sound-system streets and eat everything.
events.costNotes: London hotels spike on bank holiday weekend.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Amsterdam, Netherlands","event":"Pride Amsterdam Canal Parade","note":"Boat floats on the canals in early August."},{"destination":"Grenada","event":"Spicemas Carnival","note":"A Caribbean carnival with J'ouvert and street parades in mid-August."}]

events.hook: Red carpets and premieres on the Lido, with Venice's canals and light in early September.
events.overview: The world's oldest film festival takes over the Lido for ten days of premieres, Oscar-season buzz and star sightings. Between screenings you can ride vaporettos and get into the city after the August crowds thin. The 2027 dates are estimated from the usual late-Aug/early-Sep pattern.
events.costNotes: Festival week pushes Lido and Venice lodging well above normal September rates.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Telluride, USA","event":"Telluride Film Festival (Labor Day weekend)","note":"A smaller, more intimate festival in a Colorado mountain town."},{"destination":"San Sebastián, Spain","event":"San Sebastián International Film Festival and gastronomy","note":"Late-September films paired with some of Europe's best pintxos."}]

events.hook: Ten days of drumming, giant elephant-god idols and a million-strong sea immersion.
events.overview: Mumbai marks Lord Ganesh's birthday with towering pandal installations, nonstop music and street processions. It ends on Anant Chaturdashi with idols carried to Girgaum Chowpatty and other beaches for immersion. The festival follows the lunar calendar, so confirm the dates closer to the time.
events.costNotes: India is cheap on the ground, but flights to Mumbai are the main cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Pune, India","event":"Ganpati Festival","note":"Historic pandals and drumming troupes with fewer crowds than Mumbai."},{"destination":"Hyderabad, India","event":"Khairatabad Ganesh and Hussain Sagar immersion","note":"Home to one of India's tallest idols and a lively lakeside finale."}]

events.event: Mid-Autumn Festival and Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance
events.hook: A 70-metre dragon studded with incense sticks snakes through the streets under the harvest moon.
events.overview: The Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance is a century-old ritual held on the nights around Mid-Autumn, which falls on Sep 15, 2027. Add lantern displays in Victoria Park, mooncakes and harbourfront moon-gazing. The exact fire dragon nights are announced late, so the dates are approximate.
events.costNotes: Hotel-style housing is pricey, but food and transit are good value.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Taipei, Taiwan","event":"Mid-Autumn moon festival","note":"Neighborhood barbecues and lantern displays on a public holiday."},{"destination":"Hoi An, Vietnam","event":"Tet Trung Thu lantern festival","note":"Lantern-lit streets and lion dances."}]

events.hook: A massive square, fireworks and a rallying cry at 11 pm on the 15th.
events.overview: On the night of Sep 15 the president rings the bell and shouts the Grito from the National Palace to a packed Zócalo. The next day brings a military parade. The city's restaurants and mezcal bars run late through the weekend.
events.costNotes: Short flight and low prices make this an inexpensive trip.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Dolores Hidalgo, Mexico","event":"Birthplace of Independence celebrations","note":"Celebrate where the 1810 uprising began, in a smaller historic town."},{"destination":"Oaxaca, Mexico","event":"Independence Day weekend and mezcal tasting","note":"Local markets, music and food in the south."}]

events.hook: A town takes over its streets for four days to celebrate raw-milk cheese from around the world.
events.overview: Held in odd-numbered years in Piedmont, Slow Food's cheese fair brings together artisan producers, affinage tastings and street food. Piedmont's truffle and wine harvests are nearby. The 2027 dates are estimated from past editions.
events.costNotes: Fly into Milan or Turin and rent a car for the Langhe hills.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Alba, Italy","event":"Alba White Truffle Fair (begins Oct)","note":"Starts just after the month ends and pairs well with a Piedmont trip."},{"destination":"Logroño, Spain","event":"San Mateo Wine Harvest Festival","note":"Rioja's grape-harvest celebration with wine, parades and tapas."}]

events.hook: Teams of hundreds haul multi-ton wooden floats around street corners at full sprint.
events.overview: This lesser-known festival has run for over 300 years. Neighborhood teams pull carved danjiri floats at high speed through Kishiwada's streets, with a daredevil rider on top of each. It is held on a September weekend, and the exact 2027 dates are estimated. Osaka is a 20-minute train ride away.
events.costNotes: Use Osaka as a base; the Silver Week holiday raises lodging prices.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Takayama, Japan","event":"Hachiman Matsuri (Oct)","note":"Elaborate festival floats in a preserved old town, just after the month ends."},{"destination":"Nagano, Japan","event":"Autumn harvest and early foliage","note":"Rural festivals and harvests in the Japan Alps; not a single dated event."}]

events.hook: The world's biggest folk festival, with steins, oompah bands and lederhosen.
events.overview: Millions come to the Theresienwiese for liter beers, roast chicken and the opening-day tapping ceremony. Weekday afternoons are easier than weekends for getting a table. Combine it with day trips to the Bavarian Alps and castles.
events.costNotes: Oktoberfest-week lodging prices are the highest of the year in Munich.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Stuttgart, Germany","event":"Cannstatter Volksfest","note":"A big beer festival with shorter lines and lower lodging prices."},{"destination":"Vienna, Austria","event":"Wiener Wiesn-Fest","note":"A Viennese take on Oktoberfest, with city culture alongside."}]

events.hook: 100,000 fans pack the MCG for Australia's biggest sporting day.
events.overview: Australian rules football's Grand Final is a city-wide celebration. Fans fill pubs, parades and the iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground. The date is typically the last Saturday of September, so Sep 25 is the best estimate for 2027.
events.costNotes: Grand Final tickets are scarce and expensive; Melbourne lodging peaks that weekend.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Sydney, Australia","event":"Spring Jacaranda and harbour season starts","note":"Warmer weather arrives and the harbour wakes up; not a dated event."},{"destination":"Auckland, New Zealand","event":"Rugby Championship and spring festivals","note":"Local sport and fall-to-spring transition in a lively city."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of thousands gather in Meskel Square around a giant bonfire at dusk.
events.overview: This UNESCO-listed Ethiopian Orthodox celebration begins with the Demera bonfire on the eve and a procession in white shawls. The ceremony is a rarely visited spectacle with ancient traditions. The date follows the Ethiopian calendar, so it may be a day off.
events.costNotes: Cheap locally; the flight is the main cost.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Lalibela, Ethiopia","event":"Meskel in the rock-hewn church town","note":"A more intimate version of the celebration in an ancient pilgrimage site."},{"destination":"Gondar, Ethiopia","event":"Demera and Meskel with castles nearby","note":"Combine the festival with the royal compounds."}]

events.hook: Hundreds of hot-air balloons lift off together into a crisp high-desert sunrise.
events.overview: The world's largest hot-air balloon gathering fills Balloon Fiesta Park with mass ascensions, dawn patrol glow shows and the Special Shapes rodeo. Come for a dawn launch, stay for the evening Balloon Glow, and add a day on the Turquoise Trail or Sandia Peak.
events.costNotes: Lodging is priced at peak fiesta-week rates and you will want a rental car.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Bagan, Myanmar","event":"Dry-season hot-air balloon flights over the temple plain","note":"Similar sunrise balloon spectacle, though the season only starts around late October and travel conditions vary."},{"destination":"Cappadocia, Turkey","event":"Autumn balloon season over the fairy chimneys","note":"Daily dawn flights with milder crowds than summer."}]

events.hook: Millions of Oromo gather by Lake Hora in a sea of grass and flowers to give thanks for the end of the rains.
events.overview: Irreecha is the Oromo thanksgiving that marks the passing of the rainy season. People in traditional dress sing, bless the water with fresh grass and flowers, and celebrate with food and music. It is one of Africa's largest and least-visited cultural gatherings. Add the Rift Valley lakes and Addis Ababa.
events.costNotes: Check the exact date and location, which can shift; plan guides and security with local operators.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"Gondar, Ethiopia","event":"Meskel and Timkat-style highland celebrations","note":"Northern Ethiopia's religious festivals in castles and churches, though the main dates are outside the month."},{"destination":"Maasai Mara, Kenya","event":"Wildebeest river crossings","note":"The Mara River crossings continue into October."}]

events.event: International White Truffle Fair of Alba
events.hook: Shave fragrant white truffles over tajarin in the heart of Barolo country.
events.overview: Piedmont's famous truffle fair fills Alba with the market, tastings, cooking shows and the Truffle Auction. Surrounding Langhe vineyards are at harvest and fog-draped autumn colour. Pair it with Barolo and Barbaresco cellar visits and a truffle hunt with a trifolau and dog.
events.costNotes: Fly into Milan or Turin and rent a car; truffle meals drive the food budget.
events.alternates: [{"destination":"San Miniato, Italy","event":"White Truffle Festival (Tuscany)","note":"Late-season weekends, so it fits only the final part of the month."},{"destination":"Istria, Croatia","event":"Truffle season in Motovun","note":"Quieter and cheaper truffle country with hilltop villages."}]

events.hook: Watch the world's toughest triathletes battle lava fields and Pacific swells where Ironman began.
events.overview: The Ironman World Championship is a 2.4-mile swim, 112-mile bike and 26.2-mile run along Hawaii Island's Queen K Highway. Race week brings the Underpants Run, the Parade of Nations and an electric finish-line party on Ali'i Drive. Spectators can also snorkel with manta rays and visit Volcanoes National Park.
events.costNotes: Race-week lodging runs at a steep premium, and the race date is estimated from the usual second-Saturday pattern.

events.hook: Gilded, centuries-old festival floats glide through a perfectly preserved mountain town in autumn colour.
events.overview: One of Japan's three most beautiful floats festivals, Takayama's autumn matsuri parades ornate yatai with marionette performances and lantern-lit night processions. The old town's wooden merchant houses make a postcard backdrop. Combine it with Shirakawa-go and a Kyoto stop.
events.costNotes: Takayama lodging sells out early, so book months ahead or base in nearby Gifu or Toyama.

events.event: Jidai Matsuri and Kurama Fire Festival
events.hook: Two thousand costumed marchers recreate 1,100 years of Kyoto history by day, then flaming torches blaze in a mountain village by night.
events.overview: Jidai Matsuri parades period costumes from the Heian era to the Meiji Restoration from the Imperial Palace to Heian Shrine. That evening the Kurama Fire Festival lights huge torches in the mountain village north of the city. Kyoto's maples are only starting to turn, so crowds are lighter than in November.
events.costNotes: Kurama's fire festival has limited access and crowd control, so allow extra for transport.

events.hook: The Pink City glows as markets, palaces and rooftops are lit with millions of lights.
events.overview: Diwali lights up Jaipur, from Johari Bazaar's illuminated arches to fireworks over Amer Fort. Families clean, decorate with rangoli and exchange sweets. Dhanteras shopping and Lakshmi Puja make this a very busy but very rewarding week.
events.costNotes: Diwali dates follow the lunar calendar, so confirm them before booking flights.

events.hook: Marigold altars, comparsa parades and candlelit cemetery vigils turn Oaxaca into Mexico's most soulful party.
events.overview: Oaxaca's Day of the Dead blends Zapotec tradition and Catholic ritual. Streets fill with sand tapestries, costumed comparsas and elaborate ofrendas, and families keep all-night vigils in the panteones. Mezcal, mole and pan de muerto make it a feast as well.
events.costNotes: Book lodging months ahead, since prices rise sharply for Oct 30 - Nov 2.

events.event: Banks of the Foyle Halloween Carnival
events.hook: Derry's walled city goes full gothic carnival with Europe's biggest Halloween street party.
events.overview: Halloween is an old Celtic tradition and Derry has a huge celebration of it, with a parade, fireworks over the River Foyle and costumed crowds around the 17th-century walls. The wider week includes live music and spooky trails. Add the Giant's Causeway and the Causeway Coastal Route.
events.costNotes: Fly into Dublin or Belfast, with ground transfer to Derry included in the experiential budget.

events.hook: A whole river town turns purple as thousands of jacaranda trees bloom in Australia's spring.
events.overview: Australia's longest-running floral festival marks Grafton's blooming jacarandas with a street parade, markets, music and a crowning of the Jacaranda Queen. The Clarence River setting makes for a relaxed regional escape. Combine with Byron Bay, Bellingen and Yamba beaches.
events.costNotes: Fly into Brisbane or Ballina and hire a car; bloom timing and festival dates vary with the weather.
